description: Versioned English curriculum for children under 7. Content changes must not require code changes.

items.ask: Can you say cat?
items.hint: It says meow! It starts with c.

items.ask: Can you say dog?
items.hint: It says woof woof!

items.ask: Can you say hat?
items.hint: We wear it on our head.

items.ask: Can you say sun?
items.hint: It is up in the sky and it is bright.

items.ask: Can you say ball?
items.hint: We can roll it and bounce it.

items.ask: Can you say book?
items.hint: We look at the pictures in it.

items.ask: Can you say milk?
items.hint: We drink it. It is white.

items.ask: Can you say apple?
items.hint: It is red and crunchy.

items.ask: Can you say red?
items.hint: It is the color of a strawberry.

items.ask: Can you say blue?
items.hint: It is the color of the sky.

items.ask: Can you say green?
items.hint: It is the color of grass.

items.ask: Can you say yellow?
items.hint: It is the color of a banana.

items.ask: Can you say the letter A?
items.hint: A is for apple.

items.ask: Can you say the letter B?
items.hint: B is for ball.

items.ask: Can you say the letter C?
items.hint: C is for cat.

items.ask: Can you say mom?
items.hint: She gives you big hugs.

items.ask: Can you say star?
items.hint: It twinkles at night.

items.ask: Can you say fish?
items.hint: It swims in the water.

items.ask: Can you say duck?
items.hint: It says quack quack!

items.ask: Can you say happy?
items.hint: It is a warm, smiley feeling.

2.name: L2
2.label: Small Phrases
2.focus: nouns plus verbs, 2 to 3 word phrases

items.ask: Can you say: The cat is big.
items.hint: Say it slowly: the cat ... is ... big.

items.ask: Can you say: I see a dog.
items.hint: Say it slowly: I ... see ... a dog.

items.ask: Can you say: I like apples.
items.hint: Say it slowly: I like ... apples.

items.ask: Can you say: The ball is blue.
items.hint: Say it slowly: the ball is ... blue.

items.ask: Can you say: The dog runs.
items.hint: Say it slowly: the dog ... runs.

items.ask: Can you say: I am happy.
items.hint: Say it slowly: I am ... happy.

items.ask: Can you say: I see two cats.
items.hint: Count them: one ... two ... cats!

items.ask: Can you say: The star is small.
items.hint: Say it slowly: the star is ... small.

items.ask: Can you say: I drink milk.
items.hint: Say it slowly: I drink ... milk.

items.ask: Can you say: My hat is red.
items.hint: Say it slowly: my hat is ... red.

items.text: the bird is in the sky
items.ask: Can you say: The bird is in the sky.
items.expect: the bird is in the sky
items.hint: Say it slowly: the bird is in ... the sky.

items.ask: Can you say: The baby is sleeping.
items.hint: Say it slowly: the baby is ... sleeping.

items.text: i went to the park with my mom
items.ask: Can you say: I went to the park with my mom.
items.expect: i went to the park with my mom
items.hint: Say it in two parts: I went to the park ... with my mom.

items.text: it is raining and i have an umbrella
items.ask: Can you say: It is raining and I have an umbrella.
items.expect: it is raining and i have an umbrella
items.hint: Say it slowly, and take a breath in the middle.

items.text: i feel happy when i play with my friends
items.ask: Can you say: I feel happy when I play with my friends.
items.expect: i feel happy when i play with my friends
items.hint: Say it slowly: I feel happy ... when I play with my friends.

items.text: the sun is bright and the moon is soft
items.ask: Can you say: The sun is bright and the moon is soft.
items.expect: the sun is bright and the moon is soft
items.hint: Two parts: the sun is bright ... and the moon is soft.

items.text: once there was a little duck who liked to swim
items.ask: Can you say: Once there was a little duck who liked to swim.
items.expect: once there was a little duck who liked to swim
items.hint: Say it in three small parts.

items.text: what do you like to eat
items.ask: What do you like to eat?
items.hint: You can say: I like rice.

items.ask: What is your favorite animal?
items.hint: You can say: I like dogs.

items.ask: What color do you like?
items.hint: You can say: I like blue.

items.ask: What did you do today?
items.hint: You can say: I played with my toys.

items.text: what do you want to be
items.ask: What do you want to be when you grow up?
items.hint: You can say: I want to be a teacher.
